item.title: Walters Arrest
item.description: A 40-year-old Chillicothe woman was arrested Friday by the Caldwell County Sheriff’s Department. Krystal Marie Walters was booked on an alleged bond violation of alleged financial exploitation. Walters is held in Caldwell County with no bond set.

item.title: Sunday Afternoon Fire Destroys Livingston County Home
item.description: A fire on LIV 515 on Sunday afternoon destroyed a house and garage. The Chillicothe Fire Department received the call at 1:46 pm and arrived in about 15 minutes to find the house was fully involved. There was no one in the house. Chula and Jamesport were called for mutual aid, providing tankers for water. […]

item.title: FFA Greenhand Motivational Conference At NCMC
item.description: An estimated 400 agriculture students will travel to North Central Missouri College on Thursday for the annual Greenhand Motivational Conference for Area 2 FFA Chapters. The event is an opportunity for area high school students to meet State FFA Officers and learn more about the field of agriculture and opportunities available through FFA.

item.title: Livingston County Arrest
item.description: A Curryville, MO man facing charges of alleged possession of a controlled substance was arrested by Jackson County officers early Monday morning, on a Bond Violation warrant. Forty-year-old Javan Lee Johnson was booked into the Caldwell County Detention Center with a bond set at $25,000 – cash only.
